title: The Notice the Guest Gave and the Daily Figure on an Equipment Rental and Demo Extension
content:
A shop told in good time that kit will be kept longer can hold the stock back for it; a shop told at the last moment cannot, and the daily figure the extra days are charged at follows the notice given.

## The rule

Where the shop holds the request to keep the kit to a later date raised at least 2 days before the date written on the agreement, the daily figure is taken at the early notice share of itself. The early notice share is 92 per cent.

Where that request was raised on or after the date written on the agreement, the daily figure is taken at the late notice share of itself instead. The late notice share is 115 per cent.

In any other case nothing under this heading changes the daily figure.

## The bands

| When the request to keep the kit to a later date was raised | Share of the daily figure |
| --- | --- |
| 2 days or more before the date written on the agreement | 92 per cent |
| 1 day before the date written on the agreement | nothing under this heading |
| on the date written on the agreement, or after it | 115 per cent |

The middle row is the gap between the two: a request raised the day before the date written on the agreement is neither 2 days ahead of it nor on or after it.

## Worked figures on a hypothetical extension

Take an Equipment Rental and Demo agreement written to the 14th of January whose daily figure stands at 25.00 USD when this heading is reached.

- The request was raised on the 11th, which is 3 days before the 14th: the daily figure is 92 per cent of 25.00 USD, which is 23.00 USD.
- The request was raised on the 12th, which is 2 days before the 14th: the daily figure is again 23.00 USD.
- The request was raised on the 13th: nothing under this heading changes the 25.00 USD.
- The request was raised on the 14th, or on the 16th: the daily figure is 115 per cent of 25.00 USD, which is 28.75 USD.

## Point of judgement

**The late share raises the figure.** 115 per cent of the daily figure is more than the daily figure, so a request raised on or after the date written on the agreement costs the guest more a day than one raised the day before it.
